meta.title: Product register
meta.subtitle: Every product this site promotes, the link that was submitted for it, and what we could confirm from an official source.
meta.method: Each submitted link was fetched and the HTTP redirect chain followed to its final destination on amazon.com. The final URL, the page title and the browse-node breadcrumbs were read from that official page.
rules: The intended ASIN and the observed redirect target are recorded in two separate fields and are never merged.
Prices are not published. Amazon Program Policies 2(b) allows prices on your Site only if Amazon serves the link that displays them or you obtain pricing through Creators API or PA API.
Star ratings and review counts are not published. Amazon Program Policies 5(t) bars displaying Amazon customer reviews or star ratings unless obtained through Creators API or PA API.
No claim in this register is made from memory. Every row carries the official URL it was read from.
meta.verification_note: Token lengths and the ASIN definition were re-checked during integration on 2026-11-20. All five submitted tokens are 9 characters long, so none of them can be an ASIN under Amazon's own definition, and each observed destination is a 10-character ASIN.
